user.title: CrowPanel displays
user.description: Nothing to fill in: panels introduce themselves when they connect to Home Assistant and show up here as devices. If you see none, check that the panel is powered on and connected to this Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: Already added: new panels appear on their own.

init.title: CrowPanel panels
init.description: What would you like to do?

pannello.title: Slideshow on {pannello}
pannello.description: While the photos cycle, the panel shows the time, the date and up to {quanti} values. The label is what appears above the value: leave it empty to use the Home Assistant name, which is often long and technical.

data.spegni_dopo_min: Turn the screen off after a further (minutes)

data_description.gestito_da_ha: Clear this and the panel goes back to managing the slideshow itself, from its own web page.

firmware.title: Firmware archive
firmware.description: Versions are kept here, so going back to the previous one is a choice rather than an emergency recovery.

menu_options.fw_invia: Send a version to the panel
menu_options.fw_elimina: Remove a version from the archive

fw_carica.title: Upload a firmware
fw_carica.description: Pick the application .bin (not the bootloader nor the partition table). Name, version and build date are read from inside the file.

data_description.nome: Leave empty to use the file name.
data_description.note: To remind you what changed in this version.

fw_invia.title: Send a firmware
fw_invia.description: The panel downloads it, recomputes its fingerprint and installs it only if they match, then reboots. If the new version fails to stay up and connected to Home Assistant for two minutes, the panel restores the previous one by itself.

fw_elimina.title: Remove from the archive
fw_elimina.description: Deletes the file from Home Assistant. It does not touch the panel. Be careful not to remove the version you would want to go back to.

abort.nessun_pannello: No panel has introduced itself yet. Power one on and wait a minute.
abort.archivio_vuoto: The archive is empty: upload a firmware first.
abort.fw_mandato: Sent {nome} (version {versione}). The panel downloads, verifies and reboots: it takes a few tens of seconds.
abort.fw_non_eliminato: Nothing was deleted: the confirmation was missing.
